reportedRegression: Long N/S cliff corridors rendered diagonal green/brown zebra stripes because full rounded-plateau sample cells were repeated as west/east side segments.

visualAuthority.comparisonReference: OpenGameArt LPC Revised top-down tiling cliffs / configured Terrain Sets
visualAuthority.projection: north/east/west narrow rim strips; south rim plus full rock face

acceptance: A long west/east boundary has one continuous narrow rim and no diagonal green/brown bands.
South cliff walls contain one upper lip, continuous rock body, and one lower grass foot.
Corners are formed by intersecting orthogonal rim strips rather than repeated rounded-sample cells.
The walkable top terrain remains visible and is not replaced by source-example grass cells.
Ramps, stairs, ladders, cave mouths, bridges, waterfalls, and N5R collision semantics remain unchanged.
Missing cliff source still fails structural collision open.
